title: Developer Onboarding Kits: SDK sample packs, structured streaming & function-calling migration guides
creator: Maya Patel
description: Objective: Ship a cohesive developer onboarding kit that demonstrates best-practice usage of the Redwood SDKs for streaming responses, function-calling, and structured output. This ticket coordinates example code, migration guides for existing customers, release notes copy, and a gated rollout plan with telemetry to monitor adoption and errors. Scope includes: three language sample packs (Python, Node.js, Go), a migration guide for apps using synchronous generation to move to structured streaming + function call flows, release notes entry, and a minimal support-runbook for common migration failures.
acceptance_criteria: Three sample repositories (Python, Node.js, Go) published under /examples/sdk-onboarding with working CI that runs smoke tests against the staging SDK registry
Migration guide published in Docs: 'Migrating from sync-gen to structured streaming & function-calling' with step-by-step snippets and troubleshooting section
Release notes blurb drafted and approved by PM + Docs + DevRel
Telemetry events instrumented to track sample kit installs, sample-run failures, and migration-guide completions
Support runbook and FAQ created and reviewed by Support and SRE

rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Canary): publish sample repos and migration guide to internal customers and a small set of trial accounts (2 weeks). Monitor telemetry events, error rates, and support tickets. Phase 2 (Beta): open samples publicly, run DevRel hands-on workshops, and collect feedback (1 week). Phase 3 (GA): include release notes in SDK release, update Console sample gallery, and announce via blog + newsletter. Rollback strategy: revert sample templates and deprecate flagged guidance; provide fallback sync-gen examples if structured streaming causes regression.

risks: SDK API surface changes during runtime release could break sample code — mitigation: pin to exact staging SDK artifact and add compatibility notes
Streaming semantics edge-cases (partial JSON chunks) causing parser errors — mitigation: include robust parsing example and char-buffer approach
Insufficient telemetry coverage leading to blindspots during canary — mitigation: require instrumentation signoff before canary
Localization delay may block non-English docs — mitigation: publish English first with clear flag for translated versions
notes_for_support: Top-3 errors to expect: 429 retry behavior, streaming parse failures (incomplete JSON), function-call validation errors (missing schema)
Suggested triage steps: reproduce with sample repo + env var REDWOOD_SDK_ENDPOINT=staging, capture streaming logs, confirm SDK version pin
Escalation path: Support -> DevRel -> Runtime on-call with trace and sample request payload
release_notes_blurb: SDK 2026.03: Introducing Developer Onboarding Kits — curated sample packs and a migration guide to help teams adopt structured streaming and function-calling patterns. Includes examples for Python, Node.js, and Go plus a Support runbook. See release notes for details and migration tips.
